advice: Budget: about 40 triangles (4,520 today, 113.0 times the budget): painted into the body's texture, or a few triangles merged into the body; never a mesh of its own.
Remove its 13 hidden triangles: faces inside another part or pressed face to face, never seen.
32 bytes a vertex: quantize (position 3 x int16, normal as 2 x int8 octahedral, colour 4 x uint8): about 12-16 bytes (KHR_mesh_quantization).
Worn by the game (spec.ts randomPerson / roster.ts): bake it onto the bodies that wear it, then drop the file from the game.
Loaded at run time from public/models/people (loadProxyItem in personBuild.ts, proceduralCrowd.ts, skinAppearance.ts): ship baked bodies only, not the MakeHuman pieces.
